caption: The drawing depicts an architect's office filled with various drafting tables, each covered with blueprints and architectural drawings in black and blue tones. There are five drafting tables, each with detailed plans, drawing tools such as rulers, triangles, and pencils, and rolled-up papers placed both on the tables and in wire baskets by the sides. The room has wooden floors, light greenish-gray walls, and a ceiling with exposed beams, and features large windows along the left wall showing an urban scene outside with an American flag visible. Central to the room is a large black stove with a pipe extending upwards and horizontally across the ceiling. Hanging from the ceiling are two green-shaded lamps. The walls are decorated with framed architectural drawings and paintings, including images of classical buildings and monuments, and there is an ornate wall clock on the right. There are also various books and reference materials stacked on shelves and desks, architectural models, drafting tools like compasses and French curves, and stools around the tables. The back wall has a door with glass labeled "A. Stone & Sons Architects," and the door is surrounded by more architectural sketches. The color palette consists mainly of muted earth tones, greens, grays, blues, and browns with touches of red and gold in some details.
title: Architect's Drafting Room, 1884
